text: A muscular male figure, likely adult, stands center with a spear. Skin is olive-brown. Hair is dark, shoulder-length, wild. Face is broad, jaw prominent, expression fierce. Bare-chested, wearing simple dark loincloth. Pose: crouched forward, arms raised holding spear. Behind him, another male figure kneels, wielding a club. To left, two more figures crouch or stand. Right side shows fallen bodies. Background is rocky cave with purple and blue hues.
